name: Chiho
source: Chiho is attending a trade school to become a kindergarten teacher. Her once long hair is cut to shoulder-length and she no longer looks as young as she did in the past. Her dream is to have a small happy family and to marry the man she fell in love with in high school.
translation: Chiho is attending a trade school to become a kindergarten teacher. Her once long hair is cut to shoulder-length and she no longer looks as young as she did in the past. Her dream is to have a small happy family and to marry the man she fell in love with in high school.
